stacks.title: Multiplication on a field abelian variety
stacks.version: Current digital Stacks Project, retrieved 2026-11-08; exact HTML pin controls over mutable numbering
stacks.statement: For an abelian variety of dimension g over a field, [n] is finite locally free of degree n^(2g).
stacks.qualification: Digital source, not a claim of identity with an old printed or downloaded edition.

stacks.title: Etaleness of field multiplication
stacks.version: Current digital Stacks Project, retrieved 2026-11-08; exact HTML pin controls over mutable numbering
stacks.statement: On a nonzero abelian variety over a field, [n] is etale when n is invertible in the field.
stacks.qualification: Digital source, not a claim of identity with an old printed or downloaded edition.

stacks.title: Fibrewise flatness criterion
stacks.version: Current digital Stacks Project, retrieved 2026-11-08; exact HTML pin controls over mutable numbering
stacks.statement: For X/S flat locally of finite presentation and Y/S locally of finite type, fibrewise flatness of X -> Y implies flatness.
stacks.qualification: Digital source, not a claim of identity with an old printed or downloaded edition.

stacks.title: Etale fibres criterion
stacks.version: Current digital Stacks Project, retrieved 2026-11-08; exact HTML pin controls over mutable numbering
stacks.statement: A flat locally finitely presented morphism whose fibres are disjoint unions of finite separable field spectra is etale.
stacks.qualification: Digital source, not a claim of identity with an old printed or downloaded edition.

stacks.title: Proper quasi-finite morphisms
stacks.version: Current digital Stacks Project, retrieved 2026-11-08; exact HTML pin controls over mutable numbering
stacks.statement: A proper locally quasi-finite morphism is finite.
